notes.title: Demo v1.2.0.1 | Hard Mode Update + TD Festival!
Feline Fortress: Big Update Broadcast!
notes.content:
Hey, Steam Community!

We're a tiny indie team working on a game called Feline Fortress, and we've got some exciting news to share. We've been quietly toiling away, fueled by copious amounts of coffee and your awesome feedback, and we're finally ready to reveal our BIG update!

✨ What's New? ✨

Visual Overhaul: We've revamped the entire look of Feline Fortress. It's brighter, bolder, and more cat-tastic than ever.
Major Improvements: From gameplay tweaks to shiny UI/UX, we've listened to what you had to say and made some major improvements.


We're hosting a live broadcast to show off all the cool new stuff and answer any questions you might have. This game is a labor of love, and we couldn't have gotten this far without the support of this amazing community.

Why Should You Care?

Interactive Q&A: Ever wanted to ask us why we chose an orange cat as the main character? Now's your chance!
Sneak Peeks: Get a first look at some of the new features and changes before anyone else.
Behind-the-Scenes: Hear about the ups and downs of indie game development straight from the devs.


When & Where?
📅 Date: 16 June
⏰ Time: 7:25PM
🔗 Where: Right on Steam!

Grab a snack, settle in, and let's have some fun together. We're really excited to share this with you and can't wait to see what you think.

Thanks for being the best community ever and for all your support. See you at the broadcast!

Paws and play,
The Feline Fortress Dev Team

P.S. If you have any questions you want us to answer during the broadcast, drop them in the comments below! 🐾

notes.title: Feline Fortress Hotfix – Nextfest Demo (v1.1.0.2)
notes.content:
Hey there, Feline Fortress community!

We hope you’re enjoying the early Nextfest demo of Feline Fortress. We’re incredibly grateful for the fantastic feedback and support you’ve shown us. As a small indie team, your input is invaluable in helping us polish the game. We’ve just rolled out a hotfix to address a few key issues and make your experience even better. Here’s what’s new:

[olist]
Removed Redundant Files
[olist]
Issue: Our initial build contained some redundant files, leading to a larger installation size.
Fix: We’ve meticulously combed through the build and removed these unnecessary files, significantly reducing the overall size.
[/olist]

Compressed Over-sized Textures
[olist]
Issue: Some textures were larger than necessary, contributing to the hefty download.
Fix: We’ve compressed these textures without compromising on quality, helping to streamline the game.
[/olist]

Installation Size Reduction
[olist]
Result: Thanks to these optimizations, the installation size has been reduced from approximately 1.25GB to just around 280MB. That’s less than a quarter of the original size!
[/olist]

Fixed Inverted Gameplay Controls Bug
[olist]
Issue: Some players experienced inverted gameplay controls when opening and then closing the game menu.
Fix: We’ve squashed this pesky bug, ensuring that your controls remain consistent and responsive throughout your gameplay.
[/olist]
[/olist]

Looking Ahead

We’re continually working on improving Feline Fortress and can’t wait to bring you more updates and features. Your feedback drives our development, so please keep it coming!
 
Thank You!

We’re incredibly grateful for your support during this early stage. Every bug report and suggestion helps us create the best game possible. Together, we’re building something truly special.

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please share them in our Community Hub or join our Discord server. Your feedback is crucial, and we’re always here to listen and improve.

Stay tuned for more updates, and happy defending!

Best wishes,
The Feline Fortress Team

Thank you for being a part of this journey with us!
